items.title: Bijan Robinson: Agrees to three-year extension
items.body_text: Robinson and the Falcons have agreed to terms on a three-year extension worth up to $75 million, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Parker Washington: Strong start in training camp
items.body_text: Washington is off to a good start in training camp, according to John Shipley of SI.com. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brian Thomas: Off to good start in camp
items.body_text: Thomas has followed up his impressive spring with a good start to training camp, according to Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Trey Benson: Tending to sore knee
items.body_text: Coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Benson is dealing with discomfort in his left knee, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chris Rodriguez: Works in team drills again
items.body_text: Rodriguez (foot) worked in team drills for a second consecutive day during Monday's padded practice, John Oehser and John Shipley of the Jaguars' official site report. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
